character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Create an original, highly polished 2D pixel-art character for ShieldQuest, a cozy Singaporean urban life-simulation adventure game.

CHARACTER: Malay Singaporean female young adult wearing a hijab, approximately 18–28 years old.

ART DIRECTION:
- Cozy modern life-simulation pixel art.
- Detailed handcrafted sprite with soft shading, warm colours and clean selective outlines.
- Slightly stylized natural proportions.
- Friendly, confident, approachable appearance.

APPEARANCE:
- Medium-brown skin tone.
- Soft-coloured hijab.
- Modest modern casual clothing.
- Long-sleeve top in a gentle, harmonious colour.
- Comfortable trousers or long skirt.
- Sneakers or flats.
- Warm and confident expression.

SINGAPOREAN IDENTITY:
- Respectful, natural, everyday Singaporean representation.
- Contemporary neighbourhood or student fashion.
- Practical, warm-weather appropriate look.

SPRITE REQUIREMENTS:
- Full-body standing character, transparent background.
- Orthogonal low top-down perspective.
- Consistent proportions across all directions.
- No background, no text, no fantasy styling, no exaggerated costume.

FINAL QUALITY TARGET:
A beautiful, polished, cozy Singaporean life-sim character with a natural modern hijab-wearing look.
